name: Single-pass Solid Voxelization via XOR Bitmask Accumulation
definition: A method to voxelize watertight models in a single render pass by exploiting the Jordan curve theorem: a point is interior if a ray from it intersects the surface an odd number of times. It accumulates fragment bitmasks using XOR to determine voxel occupancy.
summary: Single-pass Solid Voxelization via XOR Bitmask Accumulation is a fast GPU method that produces fully filled interior volumes by using bitwise XOR to count surface intersections, distinguishing it from boundary-only voxelization.
